assist.toolTip: Double-blind peer review submissions: write DBPR and your manuscript number here instead of author names.

body.p: Prior to submitting your work to Nature Research, we strongly recommend that you ask at least one colleague who is unfamiliar with your software to install the tool(s), follow the instructions, and provide feedback. This process will help ensure that reviewers will also be able to run your software.
You must submit all required content as a single zip file prior to peer review or provide a link where editors and reviewers can access all required content.

value.text: Compiled standalone software and/or source code
A small (simulated or real) dataset to demo the software/code
All software dependencies and operating systems (including version numbers)
Versions the software has been tested on
Typical install time on a "normal" desktop computer
Expected run time for demo on a "normal" desktop computer
How to run the software on your data

body.p: We encourage you to include instructions for reproducing all the quantitative results in the manuscript.
Describe your software's license for use. We strongly recommend using a license approved by the Open Source Initiative.

value.text: Provide a link to the code in an open source repository (when available).
Your manuscript should include a complete, detailed description of the code's functionality (i.e. pseudocode). Please indicate where this is found:
